name: SwarmUI
tagline: Modular local image and video generation web interface powered by a ComfyUI backend with clean presets and grid tools.
real_test_summary: Tested running Flux and SDXL workflows locally through SwarmUI with its built-in ComfyUI engine. Combines prompt parameter grids and model presets without forcing raw node wiring.
pros: Combines beginner-friendly prompt controls with a full ComfyUI node backend
Built-in parameter grid generator simplifies testing seeds, samplers, and LoRAs
Supports local multi-GPU distribution and Flux, SDXL, and video models
cons: Initial installer downloads both .NET runtime and Python dependencies
Interface exposes dense settings panels that take time to customize
